deployment: none — local server only, bound to 127.0.0.1

driver.note: Synthetic pointer clicks at page coordinates were unreliable inside the preview panel (they landed off-target), so interactions were driven by real DOM events on the same widgets: typing through the browser input pipeline, then dispatching the button click. The app's own widget runtime handled every event; no test hook, monkeypatch or server-side shortcut was used in this pass.

results.observed: Title, sidebar, Malayalam form, Linear SVM model card (20,629 features, C=0.5), frozen limitations (0.9650 / 0.5378).
93-character Malayalam promotional SMS rendered a Spam result card; no error.
After a server restart with telemetry disabled, a Malayalam coordination SMS rendered a Ham result card.
Latin-only English SMS produced the Malayalam-script warning and no result card.
Single space produced 'Enter a message before analysing it.' and no result card.
The text area caps input at 5,000 characters (widget-enforced); the 5,001-character library rejection is covered by test_inference.py.
Covered by test_streamlit_app.py (U+0000/U+0001/U+0002 around Malayalam text still returns one card, no exception).
English/Latin page, Logistic Regression card (24,293 features, C=1.0), three-class scope note (0.8877).
Delivery SMS rendered a Ham card plus the model-score table.
Malayalam-only text produced the Latin-script warning and no card (browser run); also pinned by test_streamlit_app.py.
Malayalam + Latin text showed the mixed-script warning and still rendered the Ham card.
Research dashboard: 5 tabs (Overview, Dataset 1, Dataset 2, MuRIL, Block holdout), 6 metric cards, 10 dataframes, 11 chart canvases, consolidated comparison text.
Block-held-out tab revealed the classical and MuRIL block tables.
AppTest with a simulated missing artifact: the page stays usable, shows an inline error, and raises no unhandled exception.
No console errors after any interaction.

After adding [browser] gatherUsageStats = false, performance entries contain zero non-loopback requests. Before that change, Streamlit's default usage-statistics calls to data.streamlit.io and a Fivetran webhook were observed; the application code itself made none.

not_covered_in_browser: Streamlit visual/CSS layout quality and mobile viewport rendering.
